findings.evidence: `Dissociated.lean:119` `def SeparatelyDissociated`; `Dissociated.lean:155` `theorem SeparatelyDissociated.jointlyDissociated (h : SeparatelyDissociated μ X) : JointlyDissociated ...` — separate dissociation implies joint, so the unqualified name overstates what `Decomposition.lean:153,172` (`JointlyDissociated (κ u) ...`) prove.
findings.fix: Rename to `SeparatelyExchangeable.exists_jointlyDissociated_kernel` and `SeparatelyExchangeable.exists_jointlyDissociated_coding`, and say "jointly dissociated" in their docstrings and the module docstring ("a measurable mixture of dissociated ones", line ~17). `JointlyExchangeable.exists_dissociated_*` can keep their names, since there the namespace disambiguates.
findings.issue: `SeparatelyExchangeable.exists_dissociated_kernel` (and `SeparatelyExchangeable.exists_dissociated_coding`, line 166) advertise unqualified "dissociated" for components that are only `JointlyDissociated`. In the `SeparatelyExchangeable` namespace the unqualified word reads as the separate notion, which the repo defines and which is strictly stronger.

findings.evidence: Precedents in the same namespace naming the RHS: `Basic.lean:266` `separatelyExchangeable_iff_map_pairReindex`, `Extreme.lean:157` `jointlyExchangeable_iff_smulInvariantMeasure`, `RowExchangeable.lean:147` `rowExchangeable_iff_forall_prodCongrRight_mem_finitary`.
findings.fix: Rename to `separatelyExchangeable_iff_map_pairReindex_finitary` / `separatelyExchangeable_of_map_pairReindex_finitary` (or spell the condition as in `rowExchangeable_iff_forall_prodCongrRight_mem_finitary`), and update the two uses at `Extreme.lean:153`, `ConditionalLaw.lean:116` and the main-results entry at `Extreme.lean:33`.
findings.issue: `separatelyExchangeable_iff_finitary` (and `separatelyExchangeable_of_finitary`, line 111) name only the adjective "finitary"; the RHS `ρ.map (pairReindex σ τ) = ρ` is not indicated, unlike every neighbouring statement of the same shape.

summary: Two naming problems: the new separate-symmetry decomposition theorems say "dissociated" unqualified while proving only the weaker `JointlyDissociated`, in a context where `SeparatelyDissociated` exists; and `separatelyExchangeable_{of,iff}_finitary` names neither the relation asserted nor matches the adjacent `_iff_map_pairReindex` / `_iff_smulInvariantMeasure` precedent.
